title: Repeat-Bounce Taper on Mobile Wallet Resend Charges
content:
Customer care decision table for **Mobile Wallet** transfers that have bounced more than once.

**Taper rule.** The bounce taper on a resend charge follows the number of bounces on the transfer, that is its reversed-credit entries:

| Bounces on the transfer | Taper |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the charge is multiplied by 0.70 |
| exactly 2 | the charge is multiplied by 0.85 |
| a single bounce | the charge is left whole |

Every reversed credit on the transfer counts as a bounce, whatever its rejection reason.

## Hypothetical cases (charge figure 2.00)

| Reversed-credit entries on the transfer | Taper | Charge after taper |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | whole | 2.00 |
| 2 | 0.85 | 1.70 |
| 3 | 0.70 | 1.40 |
| 4 | 0.70 | 1.40 |
